title: RGraph-Eval: Task-Grounded Scene Graphs for Evaluating Robot Video Generation
title_zh: RGraph-Eval：用于评估机器人视频生成的任务锚定场景图

paragraphs.en: Generated robot videos can look convincing while depicting the wrong interaction: a different object is moved, a grasp disappears, or a placement ends outside its destination. We introduce RGraph-Eval, a reference-based framework that makes these discrepancies explicit through task-grounded temporal scene graphs. Unlike approaches that construct separate evidence representations for different evaluation dimensions, we organize task entities, interactions, and motion within a unified, interpretable scene graph representation. A foundation-model pipeline identifies manipulation roles, grounds persistent object masks, infers and verifies state transitions and action intervals, and reconstructs manipulated-object motion in three dimensions. Applying this representation to a generated video and a reference demonstration supports an interpretable RGraph-Eval score with visible-object, relation-change, and 3D path-shape components. We also introduce ShareRobot-SG, a collection of 1,000 manipulation scenes from ten ShareRobot sources annotated with the multimodal representation. Our evaluation separates graph-generation quality from agreement with human video judgments, and includes comparisons with adapted SVG2 and SG-Ego, a benchmark of three video generators. The framework connects robot-video assessment to the observable entities and interactions underlying a task, while making the graph annotations reusable beyond evaluation. Code will be publicly available at https://github.com/SashaDance/rgraph-eval .
paragraphs.zh: 生成的机器人视频可能看起来很有说服力，却描绘了错误的交互：移动了不同的物体、抓取消失，或放置未落在目标位置。 我们提出 RGraph-Eval，一个基于参考的框架，通过任务接地的时序场景图使这些差异显式化。 与为不同评估维度构建独立证据表征的方法不同，我们在统一、可解释的场景图表征中组织任务实体、交互和运动。 一个基础模型流水线识别操作角色、将持久物体掩码接地、推断并验证状态转换和动作区间，并在三维空间中重建被操作物体的运动。 将该表征应用于生成的视频和参考演示，可以支持一个可解释的 RGraph-Eval 分数，包含可见物体、关系变化和 3D 路径形状三个组成部分。 我们还提出 ShareRobot-SG，一个包含来自十个 ShareRobot 来源的 1,000 个操作场景并以该多模态表征进行标注的集合。 我们的评估将图生成质量与人类视频判断的一致性分开，并包括与适配后的 SVG2 和 SG-Ego 的比较，以及一个包含三个视频生成器的基准。 该框架将机器人视频评估与任务背后的可观测实体和交互联系起来，同时使图标注在评估之外也可复用。 代码将公开发布于 https://github.com/SashaDance/rgraph-eval 。

paragraphs.en: Video generation depicts possible robot behavior from an initial observation and a language goal, supporting behavior inspection, visual demonstrations, and data generation for robot learning ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . Generated videos can serve as an additional source of training data, complementing demonstrations collected through physical interaction. Recent work explores scalable robot data synthesis with compositional world models ( Ye et al., 2026 ) and learning robotic manipulation by imitating generated videos without physical demonstrations ( Patel et al., 2026 ) . However, using generated videos as a data source requires assessing their quality: visually realistic sequences may still depict incorrect object motion, inconsistent interactions, or failed task outcomes. Evaluation should therefore assess not only visual appearance but also whether the generated behavior preserves task-relevant entities, interactions, and final states.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成从初始观察和语言目标出发描绘可能的机器人行为，支持行为检查、视觉演示以及为机器人学习生成数据 ( Mei et al., 2026 ) 。 生成的视频可以作为额外的训练数据来源，补充通过物理交互收集的演示数据。 近期的工作探索了利用组合式世界模型进行可扩展的机器人数据合成 ( Ye et al., 2026 ) ，以及通过模仿生成的视频、无需物理演示来学习机器人操作 ( Patel et al., 2026 ) 。 然而，将生成的视频用作数据来源需要评估其质量：视觉上逼真的序列仍可能描绘错误的物体运动、不一致的交互或失败的任务结果。 因此，评估不仅应关注视觉外观，还应评估生成的行为是否保留了与任务相关的实体、交互和最终状态。

paragraphs.en: Consider the instruction “stack the white plate onto the red plate.” A plausible video can move the wrong plate, omit the grasp, or leave the white plate beside the red one. Such errors may occupy a small region while the background remains stable. Conversely, different speeds or intermediate motions can preserve the intended interaction. Evaluation must distinguish appearance, object identity, temporal interaction, and the achieved state.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑指令「把白盘子叠放到红盘子上」。一段看似合理的视频可能移动了错误的盘子、遗漏抓取动作，或者把白盘子留在了红盘子旁边。 此类错误可能只占据很小的区域，而背景保持稳定。 相反，不同的速度或中间运动可以保留预期的交互。 评估必须区分外观、物体身份、时序交互以及所达到的最终状态。

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluators address complementary parts of this problem. General video benchmarks assess visual and temporal quality ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . Robotics and world-model benchmarks emphasize instruction following and physical consistency ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Reference-based methods compare a prediction with an observed execution ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . Learned reward models additionally approximate human preferences or task progress ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ) . These approaches provide useful assessments, but their scores need not identify which visible object or interaction accounts for a disagreement. A structural representation can supply that missing connection between an assessment and the evidence in the video.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的评估器各自解决该问题的不同互补部分。 通用的视频基准评估视觉与时间质量 ( Huang et al., 2024 ) 。 机器人与世界模型基准强调指令遵循与物理一致性 ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) 。 基于参照的方法将预测与观测到的执行进行对比 ( Wei et al., 2026 ) 。 学习型奖励模型还进一步近似人类偏好或任务进度 ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ) 。 这些方法能够提供有用的评估，但其分数未必能指出是哪个可见物体或交互导致了分歧。 结构化表示可以在评估与视频中的证据之间提供这一缺失的联系。

paragraphs.en: Task-grounded temporal scene graphs connect assessment to this evidence. We call these graphs task-grounded because their entities and relations are selected with respect to the manipulation goal: they represent the robot, manipulated object, relevant supports and target, and their task-relevant interactions rather than exhaustively describing the entire scene. Nodes identify task entities, masks ground them in image regions, relations describe changing interactions, and trajectories capture motion.
paragraphs.zh: 任务导向的时序场景图将评估与这一证据联系起来。 我们将这些图称为任务导向的，因为其实体和关系是围绕操作目标来选取的：它们表示机器人、被操作物体、相关的支撑物与目标，以及它们与任务相关的交互，而不是详尽地描述整个场景。 节点标识任务实体，掩码将实体定位到图像区域，关系描述不断变化的交互，轨迹则捕捉运动。

paragraphs.en: Graph-based assessment depends on extraction quality: incorrect object assignments propagate through tracking, relations, and geometry, while language models may infer goal-consistent rather than observed outcomes. We address these risks through visual grounding, persistent tracking, and independent verification, and evaluate graph quality separately from human alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图的评估依赖于提取质量：错误的对象归属会传播到跟踪、关系和几何信息中，而语言模型可能推断出与目标一致而非实际观察到的结果。 我们通过视觉定位、持久跟踪和独立验证来应对这些风险，并将图质量评估与人类一致性评估分开进行。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes the framework. We make three contributions. First, we introduce a foundation-model pipeline for annotating manipulation videos with grounded temporal graphs, including masks, states, actions, and estimated 3D motion. Second, we present ShareRobot-SG, a 1,000-scene collection spanning ten manipulation sources for studying the quality and breadth of this representation. Third, we introduce reference-based RGraph-Eval assessment with an explicit component decomposition, evaluated through human alignment, generator comparison, and component analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 图1总结了该框架。 我们做出了三项贡献。 首先，我们引入了一个基础模型流水线，用于为操作视频标注带有时间定位的图，包括掩码、状态、动作和估计的三维运动。 其次，我们提出 ShareRobot-SG，这是一个包含一千个场景的数据集，覆盖十种操作来源，用于研究这种表示的质量与广度。 第三，我们引入了基于参考的 RGraph-Eval 评估，并给出显式的组件分解，通过人类一致性、生成器比较和组件分析来进行评估。

paragraphs.en: PSNR measures pixel-wise reconstruction error, SSIM compares local structure ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS measures learned perceptual distance ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Frame-wise appearance similarity does not explicitly assess manipulated-object identity, interaction, or task completion ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .

For manipulation, neither background stability nor a plausible final image establishes coherent robot–object interaction.

paragraphs.en: Human-aligned evaluators include TIQA, which learns text-quality prediction for generated images from human ratings ( Koltsov et al., 2026 ) , and VideoReward, which learns video preference dimensions ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . VideoScore2 assesses visual quality, text alignment, and physical consistency ( He et al., 2025 ) , while RoboReward estimates robotic task progress ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Ref4D-VideoBench compares reference and generated videos across semantics, events, and other dimensions ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . We instead make grounded objects, masks, relation changes, and geometry the comparison interface.
paragraphs.zh: 与人类对齐的评估器包括 TIQA 和 VideoReward：TIQA 从人类评分中学习对生成图像的文本质量预测（Koltsov et al., 2026），VideoReward 学习视频偏好维度（Liu et al., 2025）。 VideoScore2 评估视觉质量、文本对齐和物理一致性（He et al., 2025），而 RoboReward 估计机器人任务进度（Lee et al., 2026）。 Ref4D-VideoBench 在语义、事件等维度上对参考视频与生成视频进行比较（Wei et al., 2026）。 我们则将定位到的物体、掩码、关系变化和几何结构作为比较接口。

paragraphs.en: Visual Genome and Action Genome establish object–relation representations for image and video understanding ( Krishna et al., 2017 ; Ji et al., 2020 ) . Recent annotation pipelines use foundation models to extend graph generation beyond fixed object categories. SVG2 extracts large-scale spatiotemporal scene graphs from video ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . SG-Ego supports scene-based reasoning about human activities ( Pistilli et al., 2026 ) . Their broad object vocabularies make them relevant comparisons for manipulation-focused extraction.
paragraphs.zh: Visual Genome 和 Action Genome 为图像与视频理解建立了对象–关系表示 ( Krishna et al., 2017 ; Ji et al., 2020 ) 。 近期的标注流水线利用基础模型将图生成扩展到固定对象类别之外。 SVG2 从视频中提取大规模时空场景图 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) 。 SG-Ego 支持基于场景的人类活动推理 ( Pistilli et al., 2026 ) 。 它们广泛的对象词表使其成为面向操作任务抽取工作的相关对比方法。

paragraphs.en: Our pipeline combines open-vocabulary object descriptions with task roles and an explicit state–action schema. We adapt SVG2 and SG-Ego to the same manipulation setting, although these methods naturally produce broad scene-description relations, including geometric relations. Such predicates are useful for general scene understanding, but they are not sufficient to determine whether a manipulation was executed correctly. Moreover, when ground-truth-quality depth and camera geometry are available, they can be computed directly from reconstructed 3D object positions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的流水线将开放词汇的目标描述与任务角色以及显式的状态–动作模式相结合。 我们将 SVG2 和 SG-Ego 适配到相同的操作设置中，尽管这些方法通常产生宽泛的场景描述关系，包括几何关系。 这类谓词对于一般场景理解很有用，但它们不足以判定一次操作是否被正确执行。 此外，当具备真值质量的深度和相机几何信息时，这些谓词可以直接根据重建的三维目标位置计算得到。

paragraphs.en: Scene graphs already support robotic perception, planning, and control. VeriGraph uses graph structure to verify robot plans ( Ekpo et al., 2026 ) , and Compose by Focus uses task-relevant scene graphs for skill composition ( Qi et al., 2026 ) . SG-RAPL uses a 3D scene graph to ground language-driven, hierarchical action planning for humanoid robots in warehouse environments ( Yudin et al., 2026 ) . These works establish that structured object relations have value beyond image description.
paragraphs.zh: 场景图已经支持机器人感知、规划与控制。 VeriGraph 使用图结构来验证机器人计划（Ekpo et al., 2026），而 Compose by Focus 使用与任务相关的场景图进行技能组合（Qi et al., 2026）。 SG-RAPL 使用三维场景图，为仓储环境中的人形机器人提供基于语言的分层动作规划的落地（Yudin et al., 2026）。 这些工作表明，结构化的物体关系在图像描述之外也具有价值。

paragraphs.en: Despite these applications, datasets pairing robotic manipulation observations with explicit scene-graph annotations remain relatively scarce. SG-Bot provides a synthetic tabletop dataset with graph, depth, and segmentation annotations ( Zhai et al., 2024 ) . EmbodimentSemantic pairs real-robot observations with spatial scene graphs and provides a simulator-grounded manipulation benchmark ( Jaber and others, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: The pipeline takes the goal and ordered RGB frames as input and follows the five stages in Fig. 2 . It selects grounding keyframes internally and requires no external masks, hand-labelled boxes, or demonstration planning steps. paragraphs.en: We ground four core task roles: robot, manipulated object, initial support, and target, with an optional whole-parent entity for part–whole interactions. Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) uses the goal and ordered frames to describe each entity and predict grounding boxes at selected keyframes. These descriptions provide segmentation prompts, while the boxes disambiguate visually similar objects. A verification pass checks the proposed entities against the frames, and visual evidence takes precedence when it conflicts with the goal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为四个核心任务角色进行定位：机器人、被操作物体、初始支撑物和目标，并提供一个可选的整父实体用于部分–整体交互。 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen 团队，2026）利用目标和有序帧来描述每个实体，并在选定的关键帧上预测定位框。 这些描述提供分割提示，而定位框则用于消解视觉上相似物体之间的歧义。 验证环节会将提出的实体与帧进行核对，当视觉证据与目标冲突时，以视觉证据为准。

paragraphs.en: The grounded descriptions and boxes define which objects to track. Each prompt may produce several candidate tracks when objects look similar. We select the intended tracks using overlap between their masks and the grounding boxes from Qwen3.8-27B. The boxes are used after segmentation to select tracks, not as prompts to SAM 3.
paragraphs.zh: 定位描述和边界框定义了需要跟踪哪些物体。 SAM 3（Carion et al., 2025）将这些描述作为文本提示，从 RGB 序列中生成候选掩码轨迹。 当物体看起来相似时，每个提示可能产生多个候选轨迹。 我们利用掩码与来自 Qwen3.8-27B 的定位框之间的重叠来选择目标轨迹。 这些框在分割之后用于选择轨迹，而不是作为 SAM 3 的提示。

paragraphs.en: Once objects are identified and tracked, we add relations and actions to describe their interactions. Relations represent interaction states, while actions describe events over time. For example, holding is a robot–object relation, while grab and release mark changes in that relation. We keep states and actions separate.

paragraphs.en: One assessor rated 90 videos generated from the 30-scene generation subset (30 videos per generator) on task completion, object consistency, and visual quality, each from 1 to 5. For each video, the overall human rating is the arithmetic mean of its task-completion, object-consistency, and visual-quality ratings, with equal weight for all three. Following a correlation-evaluation protocol similar to RBench ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , we average each automatic score and each human-rating measure over the 30 videos per generator and compute Pearson’s r r across the three generator means. The Mean column in Tables 3 and 6 reports correlation with this overall human rating, not the average of the correlations for the individual criteria. Generation is conditioned on planning annotations from ShareRobot, because these annotations can be ambiguous and may not uniquely specify the demonstrated execution.

RGraph-Eval and RBench tie for the highest reported task-completion correlation, while RGraph-Eval shows the strongest correlation with visual quality and the overall human rating. paragraphs.zh: 表 3 比较了由作者提供的各聚合分数，并单独保留了 Ref4D 的事件分数。 RGraph-Eval 与 RBench 在报告的任务完成度相关性上并列最高，而 RGraph-Eval 在与视觉质量及人类总体评分的相关性上表现最强。 Ref4D 的事件分数与对象一致性相关性最强。 这些结果表明，RGraph-Eval 所使用的结构化表示捕捉到了人类判断的互补方面：关系变化直接反映预期的操控是否被执行，而持续的对象定位与 3D 运动则为对象一致性提供了额外的证据。

paragraphs.en: We further use the same 30-scene generation subset to compare the three video generation models directly. Table 4 compares Cosmos 3 Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and WoW-1-Wan-14B-2M ( Chi et al., 2025 ) . These results highlight that the generators differ not only in overall quality, but in which aspects of the manipulation sequence they preserve most faithfully.

paragraphs.en: We conduct two ablations to examine the main design choices of RGraph-Eval: the tracking pipeline used to construct persistent object representations and the components used to compute the final evaluation score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了两项消融实验，以检验 RGraph-Eval 的主要设计选择：用于构建持久化对象表征的跟踪流程，以及用于计算最终评估得分的各组成部分。

paragraphs.en: The tracking ablation isolates the effects of semantic prompting and temporal mask repair. We compare four tracking variants on 100 valid annotated videos from ShareRobot-SG, using the same ten frames per video and fixed Qwen proposals. Removing SAM2.1 missing-frame repair substantially reduces tracking recall, showing that temporal repair is important for maintaining object visibility across the sequence. Box-prompted SAM2.1 provides strong precision, but does not recover the recall of the full pipeline, while box-prompted SAM3 performs worse overall. Together, these results indicate that text-based semantic prompting and SAM2.1 temporal repair provide complementary benefits for persistent object grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪消融实验分离了语义提示与时序掩码修复的影响。 我们在 ShareRobot-SG 的 100 段有效标注视频上比较四种追踪变体，每个视频使用相同的十帧和固定的 Qwen 提案。 移除 SAM2.1 缺失帧修复会显著降低追踪召回率，表明时序修复对于在整个序列中维持目标可见性非常重要。 框提示的 SAM2.1 具有很强的精确率，但无法恢复完整流程的召回率，而框提示的 SAM3 整体表现更差。 综合来看，这些结果表明基于文本的语义提示与 SAM2.1 时序修复为目标持续定位提供了互补的收益。

paragraphs.en: The score ablation examines the contribution of visible-object agreement ( O O ), relation changes ( R R ), and 3D path shape ( T T ) using the same 90 generated videos and human ratings from the 30-scene generation subset. Relation changes provide the strongest standalone alignment with task completion, indicating that changes in manipulation state are particularly informative for judging whether the intended interaction is performed. Visible objects and 3D motion provide complementary information, and combining components generally improves alignment with human judgments. The full score shows the strongest task-completion alignment, whereas the combination of relations and 3D path shape aligns most strongly with the overall human rating. This suggests that the components capture different aspects of generated robot behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 分数消融实验在相同的 90 个生成视频以及来自 30 个场景生成子集的人类评分上，考察了可见物体一致性（ O O ）、关系变化（ R R ）和 3D 路径形状（ T T ）的贡献。 关系变化与任务完成的对齐程度在单独使用时最强，这表明操作状态的变化对于判断预期的交互是否被执行特别具有信息量。 可见物体和 3D 运动提供互补的信息，组合各分量通常能提升与人类判断的对齐程度。 完整分数显示出最强的任务完成对齐，而关系与 3D 路径形状的组合则与整体人类评分的对齐最强。 这表明各分量捕捉了生成的机器人行为的不同方面。

paragraphs.en: We introduced RGraph-Eval, a reference-based evaluator that represents robot videos with task-grounded scene graphs combining object grounding, interaction changes, and 3D motion. We also introduced ShareRobot-SG, a 1,000-scene dataset with multimodal scene-graph annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RGraph-Eval，这是一个基于参考的评估器，它使用结合了物体定位、交互变化和三维运动的任务锚定场景图来表示机器人视频。 我们还提出了 ShareRobot-SG，这是一个包含 1,000 个场景的数据集，带有多模态场景图标注。

sents.en: We introduced RGraph-Eval, a reference-based evaluator that represents robot videos with task-grounded scene graphs combining object grounding, interaction changes, and 3D motion.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 RGraph-Eval，这是一个基于参考的评估器，它使用结合了物体定位、交互变化和三维运动的任务锚定场景图来表示机器人视频。

sents.en: We also introduced ShareRobot-SG, a 1,000-scene dataset with multimodal scene-graph annotations.
sents.zh: 我们还提出了 ShareRobot-SG，这是一个包含 1,000 个场景的数据集，带有多模态场景图标注。

paragraphs.en: Across the video-generation benchmark, RGraph-Eval shows strong agreement with human judgments and captures complementary aspects of generated behavior through visible objects, relation changes, and object motion. The component analysis further indicates that these signals contribute differently to task-completion and overall human alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 在视频生成基准测试中，RGraph-Eval 与人类判断表现出高度一致性，并通过可见物体、关系变化和物体运动捕捉生成行为的互补方面。 组件分析进一步表明，这些信号对任务完成度和整体人类对齐度的贡献各不相同。

sents.en: Across the video-generation benchmark, RGraph-Eval shows strong agreement with human judgments and captures complementary aspects of generated behavior through visible objects, relation changes, and object motion.
sents.zh: 在视频生成基准测试中，RGraph-Eval 与人类判断表现出高度一致性，并通过可见物体、关系变化和物体运动捕捉生成行为的互补方面。

sents.en: The component analysis further indicates that these signals contribute differently to task-completion and overall human alignment.
sents.zh: 组件分析进一步表明，这些信号对任务完成度和整体人类对齐度的贡献各不相同。

paragraphs.en: Extraction errors and single-reference comparison remain limitations, and valid alternative executions may receive lower scores. The current representation also focuses on a single manipulated object and does not certify executable actions. Within this scope, RGraph-Eval provides an interpretable evaluation based on the entities and interactions underlying the task.
paragraphs.zh: 抽取错误和单一参照比较仍是其局限，有效的替代执行方式可能获得较低的分数。 当前的表示也只聚焦于单个被操作对象，且无法认证动作是否可执行。 在此范围内，RGraph-Eval 基于任务底层的实体与交互提供了一种可解释的评估方式。

paragraphs.en: We plan to use object, relation, and motion discrepancies for iterative video refinement. Future work will also consider multi-object and bimanual representations, multi-reference comparisons, uncertainty-aware scoring, and evaluation on a larger benchmark covering a broader range of video-generation models, including closed-source systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计划利用物体、关系和运动差异进行迭代式视频优化。 未来的工作还将考虑多物体和双手操作表征、多参考比较、不确定性感知评分，以及在覆盖更广泛视频生成模型（包括闭源系统）的更大规模基准上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: This work was partially carried out as part of the research project “Improving Video-Based Visual-Spatial Question Answering Using 3D Scene Graphs” under an agreement with Innopolis university.
